meta.environment: static analysis only; application not started, no database, no HTTP exchange observed
meta.scope: the six workflows named in the phase-6 brief, plus the six unit-test files and the requirement nodes those workflows traverse

confidence_key.confirmed: every edge traced to a file:line in this repository
confidence_key.suspected: the edge is implied by code structure but a step in the chain was not line-traced, or its reachability depends on runtime state that was not observed

meta.regression_rule: when a change touches node X, the regression set is X plus every node reachable by following consumed_by transitively; test nodes reachable that way are the tests that already guard the change

nodes.label: WF1 — Admin login to dashboard
Login page — redirects an already-signed-in actor by role
LoginForm — email, password, hidden callbackUrl; noValidate
login() server action — Zod parse, safeCallback open-redirect guard, signIn
loginSchema
GET/POST /api/auth/[...nextauth] — NextAuth v5 handler, JWT session, 8h maxAge
Credentials.authorize — rate limit, bcrypt compare against DUMMY_HASH when user absent, lastLoginAt + ActivityLog in one transaction
rateLimit() — Postgres fixed-window counter, raw SQL upsert on RateLimit.key
getAdminUser() — re-reads the User row from Postgres on every request (REQ-SEC-026)
requireAdminPage(role?) — redirect: no user to /admin/login, PORTAL_USER to /club, non-ADMIN to /admin
requireAdmin(role?) — throws UnauthorizedError; PORTAL_USER always denied
proxy() — optimistic cookie-presence redirect for /admin; /club /volunteer /donor excluded; locale prefixing
authConfig.callbacks.authorized — DEAD: proxy.ts does not import authConfig and nothing exports auth as middleware
Admin dashboard output — evidence coverage, content counts, recent messages, recent ActivityLog
User (Postgres) — Role ADMIN|EDITOR|PORTAL_USER; ~25 inbound relations, nearly all onDelete Restrict
RateLimit (Postgres) — PK on key confirmed in init migration SQL
ActivityLog (Postgres) — written by login and every admin mutation; userId onDelete SetNull and unindexed
AuditEvent (Postgres) — immutable by SQL trigger; written by every operational service; only reader found is the admin club detail page
NotificationOutbox (Postgres) — rows written inside the business transaction; no consumer moves PENDING to SENT
MISSING consumer — no cron, queue worker or sender exists; outbox rows are written and displayed only
WF2 — Club membership request to active membership (reviewer is a trust ADMIN, not the coordinator)
/club — my memberships plus paginated active-club explorer
MembershipRequest — adult + consent checkboxes, both required client-side
requestMyClubMembership — getAdminUser, consent re-check, rate limit club-request 10/h
requestClubMembership — self-scope guard, club must be ACTIVE, Serializable transaction, writes membership + history + audit; writes NO outbox row
/admin/clubs/[id] — ClubAdminEditor; loads every User row and every membership with full history, unbounded
admin/clubs.ts run() wrapper — requireAdmin('ADMIN') for all 8 exported club actions
decideMembership — APPROVE|REJECT with optimistic version and free-text reason
reviewClubMembership — REASON_REQUIRED on reject, status/version conflict check, club ACTIVE check, SELF_APPROVAL ban, current-consent re-check
setCoordinator -> appointClubCoordinator — requires an ACTIVE membership first; demotes the previous coordinator
requireClubCoordinator — membership ACTIVE and role COORDINATOR and club ACTIVE and club.coordinatorId === userId (REQ-CLUB-032)
/club/[id] coordinator workspace — roster (name + email), private documents, assigned projects
POST /api/admin/clubs/[id]/documents — ADMIN only, host-only same-origin, sniff, stores under private/club-documents/, compensating delete on failure
GET /api/club/documents/[id]/file — ADMIN bypass else requireClubCoordinator; no storage-key-prefix check (QA-API-001)
Club (Postgres) — DRAFT|ACTIVE|SUSPENDED|ARCHIVED, optimistic version, no delete path anywhere
ClubMembership (Postgres) — unique (clubId,userId); INVITED|REQUESTED|ACTIVE|REJECTED|SUSPENDED|ENDED; carries consentAt/adultAttestedAt/consentVersion
ClubMembershipHistory (Postgres) — immutable by SQL trigger
ClubDocument (Postgres row) + private file bytes; mediaId onDelete Restrict; the only evidence table with a working archive writer
WF3 — Volunteer attendance and service log to approved hours
/volunteer VolunteerWorkspace — profile+consent, availability, attendance, service-hours forms; hours form only rendered for APPROVED attendance without an existing log
volunteer/records.ts run() wrapper — getAdminUser + rate limit volunteer-write 30/h, feeds all five portal actions
saveMyVolunteerProfile -> saveVolunteerProfile — consent version gate, optimistic version
submitMyAttendance — attendanceSchema parse
submitAttendance — no future date, current consent version, ACTIVE membership of an ACTIVE club (REQ-VOL-037)
submitMyServiceLog — serviceLogSchema parse
submitServiceLog — attendance must be the actor's own, APPROVED, club ACTIVE, with no existing log; membership re-checked
/admin/volunteers — paginated profile, attendance and service-hour review queues; renders VolunteerReview for every row with no self-record exclusion
VolunteerReview — decision select + reason input with no required/minLength (QA-UI-001)
decideVolunteerRecord — requireAdmin('ADMIN'), kind/id/version/decision/reason parse

reviewVolunteerRecord — reason >=3 chars for non-approve, version/status conflict, SELF_APPROVAL ban, VOID cascades to the attached service log, hours need APPROVED attendance (REQ-VOL-038, REQ-VOL-039)
Confirmed total — aggregate sum of minutes where log APPROVED and attendance APPROVED
VolunteerProfile (Postgres) — one per user, carries consentVersion and shareSkillsWithClubs
VolunteerAttendance (Postgres) — serviceDate is @db.Date; SUBMITTED|APPROVED|REJECTED|VOIDED; history immutable by trigger
VolunteerServiceLog (Postgres) — one per attendance; minutes integer; voided transitively when its attendance is voided
WF4 — Task assignment, volunteer evidence upload, completion review
/admin/project-operations/[id] TaskRow — assign, dependency, completion review (status SUBMITTED), administrative status, collapsed history+evidence, admin evidence upload gated only on not-closed
admin/project-operations.ts run() wrapper — requireAdmin('ADMIN') for all 11 actions; revalidates /admin, /volunteer/tasks and /club
setTaskVolunteer — task open, project PLANNED|ACTIVE, assignment+club ACTIVE, current consented volunteer profile, ACTIVE membership; writes TaskAssignment + history + audit + outbox
/volunteer/tasks — paginated list filtered by active assignment, current consent, project/assignment/club ACTIVE and live membership
/volunteer/tasks/[id] — requireVolunteerTask then render; TaskProgress gates both the progress form and the evidence section on editable = TODO|IN_PROGRESS and no open dependency
updateAssignedTask — getAdminUser, rate limit project-task-progress 60/h, taskProgressSchema
updateMyTask — version check, scope check, live membership, status TODO|IN_PROGRESS only, all predecessors APPROVED, submit requires 100%
requireVolunteerTask — project ACTIVE, assignment ACTIVE, club ACTIVE, active assignment at the current consent version, plus a live membership re-check (REQ-PRJ-040)
requireTaskReader — ADMIN bypass, else assigned volunteer, else viewing coordinator
requireProjectClubCoordinator — assignment ACTIVE, club ACTIVE, coordinator match, project ACTIVE|PLANNED, permission flag, live membership (REQ-CLUB-033)
TaskEvidenceUpload — fetch POST with manual pending/error state; used by both the volunteer task page and the admin TaskRow
POST /api/project-tasks/[id]/evidence — host+protocol same-origin, getAdminUser, ADMIN bypass else requireVolunteerTask, rate limit 60/h, size/MIME/magic-byte, compensating deleteStoredFile
createTaskEvidenceFromUpload — storage-key namespace enforced, task status must be TODO|IN_PROGRESS for EVERY actor including ADMIN, writes Media + ProjectTaskEvidence + task history + audit
GET /api/task-evidence/[id]/file — archivedAt filter, PRIVATE visibility, storage-key prefix check, requireTaskReader; private no-store headers
decideTask — APPROVE|RETURN, optimistic version, reason max 1000
reviewTaskCompletion — reason >=3 on RETURN, status must be SUBMITTED, SELF_APPROVAL ban on any assignee, APPROVE requires predecessors APPROVED and subtasks resolved (REQ-VOL-038)
Task APPROVED with completedAt; unblocks dependants and permits milestone/project completion
ProjectTask (Postgres) — TODO|IN_PROGRESS|SUBMITTED|BLOCKED|APPROVED|CANCELLED, optimistic version, milestoneId unindexed
TaskAssignment (Postgres) — unique (taskId,profileId), active flag, assignedAt/endedAt
ProjectTaskHistory (Postgres) — immutable by SQL trigger; records every progress, assignment, evidence and review event
ProjectTaskEvidence (Postgres row) + private bytes; mediaId onDelete Restrict; archivedAt has a read filter but no writer (QA-DB-004)
WF5 — Admin uploads media, attaches it to a document, publishes publicly
Media library — filter pills, search, visibility toggle, upload; delete dialog copy contradicts the server rule (QA-UI-002)
MediaPicker — attaches a Media id into a hidden input on every content form
POST /api/admin/upload — host-only same-origin, requireAdmin (ADMIN or EDITOR), rate limit 120/h, size/MIME/magic-byte, no compensating delete (QA-DB-003)
GET /api/admin/media — operational-private prefixes hidden from non-ADMIN (REQ-MEDIA-007); backing query capped at 500 with no pagination (QA-DB-006)
storeFile() — local filesystem by default, Vercel Blob when STORAGE_DRIVER=vercel-blob; namespaced key decides the private prefix
readPrivateFile() — path-traversal guard on the local driver; Blob get on the blob driver
documentSchema — published public document needs a public file; personal data needs isRedacted (REQ-DOC-001, REQ-DOC-004)
saveDocument — public slot must be PUBLIC media, original slot must be PRIVATE and non-operational; publishedAt stamped once; expires 6 cache tags
expire() — updateTag per cache tag plus refresh(); direct DB and seed writes bypass it
deleteMedia — operational-private files refused to non-ADMIN, published PUBLIC Document.fileId usage blocked (REQ-DOC-005); no other reference is checked
Public document surface — PUBLIC_DOCUMENT_WHERE allowlist; private media never reaches a public DTO (REQ-DOC-006)
Media (Postgres row + filesystem/Blob bytes) — storageKey unique; 16 inbound SetNull relations, 4 Restrict, 1 Cascade; uploadedById unindexed
Document (Postgres) — file / originalFile / thumbnail all onDelete SetNull; isRedacted, containsPersonalData, visibility, status
GalleryImage (Postgres) — the only onDelete Cascade in the schema; mediaId is a non-leading unique column so the cascade scan is unindexed
WF6 — Manual donation intake to donor visibility; terminates at PENDING_VERIFICATION, the only state the enum has
/admin/donations — ADMIN only; donor list, published non-demo project list, 100 most recent donations; mints a fresh idempotencyKey per render
DonorLinkForm — email, type, organizationName; permanently disabled anonymousByDefault checkbox (QA-REQ-007), no client mirror of the conditional org rule (QA-UI-003)
ManualDonationIntakeForm — hidden idempotencyKey, hardcoded empty campaignId (QA-UI-004), silently disabled submit when prerequisites are empty (QA-UI-005)
admin/donations.ts run() wrapper — requireAdmin('ADMIN'); the only module family whose error payload carries a machine-readable code (QA-API-004)
linkDonorAccount — donorProfileSchema parse then createDonorProfile
createDonorProfile — the target account must already exist AND be PORTAL_USER (REQ-DON-043); anonymousByDefault never written
recordManualDonationIntake — manualDonationIntakeSchema parse; revalidates /admin/donations and /donor

createPendingManualDonation — idempotency key plus SHA-256 request fingerprint, donor must be PORTAL_USER, project must be PUBLISHED and non-demo, campaign must match the project; status hardcoded PENDING_VERIFICATION
POST /api/admin/donations/[id]/evidence — ADMIN only, donation must be PENDING_VERIFICATION, rate limit 40/h, compensating delete
/donor — own donor profile only, 100 most recent donations, status cell is the literal string 'Pending verification' rather than the row's status
Terminal state — PENDING_VERIFICATION forever; no verification, receipt, allocation or confirmed total exists (REQ-APPR-046 inert by design)
DonorProfile (Postgres) — one per user, anonymousByDefault default true and never read
Donation (Postgres) — amountPaise BigInt, currency INR, status PENDING_VERIFICATION, unique idempotencyKey; SQL CHECK constraints enforce all three
DonationHistory (Postgres) — immutable by SQL trigger; snapshot written at intake
DonationEvidence (Postgres row) + private bytes; mediaId onDelete Restrict; archivedAt has no writer
src/lib/approval/definition.test.ts — approval policy/scope definitions (REQ-APPR-046)
src/lib/validations/fundraising.test.ts — rupeesToPaise / formatPaise; the only unit test reachable from WF6 (via amount conversion)
src/lib/validations/donations.test.ts — donorProfileSchema and manualDonationIntakeSchema only; no service, action or route is exercised
src/server/payments/provider.test.ts — tests a module with no importer anywhere in src/
src/lib/finance/chart.test.ts — tests a module with no importer anywhere in src/ (Phase-7 ledger design)
src/lib/finance/journal-core.test.ts — tests a module with no importer anywhere in src/ (Phase-7 ledger design)
scripts/verify-club-ui.ts — headed Playwright harness named by REQ-CLUB-032/035/036 and REQ-MEDIA-007; needs system Chrome and a disposable Postgres; NOT in npm run check
scripts/verify-volunteer-ui.ts — named by REQ-VOL-037/038; never executed in this run
scripts/verify-project-ui.ts — named by REQ-CLUB-033 and REQ-PRJ-040; never executed in this run
scripts/verify-donations-ui.ts — named by REQ-DON-043; never executed in this run
scripts/verify-portal-workflow-ui.ts — the only harness that spans several portals end to end; not referenced by any requirement row
NO TEST — nothing covers authorize(), the login limiter, requireAdmin/requireAdminPage or any API route handler (QA-TEST-003)
NO TEST — nothing covers deleteMedia's reference guards, saveDocument's slot rules or the public publication gate
REQ-SEC-030 — sign-in, contact form and uploads are rate limited (PARTIAL, QA-AUTH-001)
REQ-CLUB-034 — adult self-attestation plus current versioned consent; a trust admin decides and cannot approve their own request (SATISFIED)
REQ-VOL-038 — review can never be self-review, for volunteer records or task completion (SATISFIED)
REQ-VOL-039 — only APPROVED minutes linked to APPROVED attendance count; voiding attendance voids its hours (SATISFIED)
REQ-PRJ-040 — a volunteer needs a current consented profile, active membership and an explicit active assignment (SATISFIED)
REQ-DOC-005 — media deletion must be rejected while the file backs a published public document (SATISFIED for Document.fileId only)
REQ-DON-043 — donor profiles link existing PORTAL_USER accounts only; intake needs a published non-demo project (SATISFIED)
REQ-DON-044 — donor profiles default to anonymous public display (UNIMPLEMENTED, QA-REQ-007); the donor page asserts it in prose
REQ-DON-045 — donors see only their own pending history (SATISFIED)
REQ-NOTIF-047 — a financial mutation is never retried merely because notification delivery failed (UNVERIFIABLE: no delivery exists)
